meta.notes: Edges filtered: reference===3 AND type==='bechina'. 15 bechina edges yielded 11 raw connected components. Six small isolated pairs were merged into the three larger thematically-matching packages. One component (אילן/אברהם/חסד) stands alone as Package D — it is the chesed-protection cluster, thematically distinct from the music/malkhut and night-learning clusters.

packages.label: נְגִינָה וּמַלְכוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה
packages.label_en: Holy Music and the Kingdom of Holiness
packages.reason: The central thematic cluster of Torah #3 is the identity of holy music (נגינה) with the building (בנין) of malkhut deKedushah. The two holy birds (שתי צפרים חיות טהורות) ARE the building of holy malkhut; the root of holy music IS the mochin/da'at of malkhut deKedushah; the cherubim ARE the two birds; the musician/cantor (חזן, מנגן) IS prophecy because music draws from the same source as prophecy; the frog (צפרדע) IS the bird of knowledge (צפור דעה), the allegorical singer of the whole Talmudic narrative. All these nodes share the essential nature of 'holy music as spiritual royalty.' They are all different expressions of the same metaphysical reality: the dimension of malkhut where the word of prophecy and song unite.
merge_notes: CC3 {שתי צפרים חיות טהורות, בנין המלכות דקדשה} merged here: the holy birds ARE the building of malkhut deKedushah — same essential reality as CC2's נגינה=בנין המלכות.
CC6 {שרש הנגינה שבקדשה, מחין ודעת של מלכות דקדשה} merged here: the root of holy music is explicitly identified as the mochin/da'at of holy malkhut — core of this package.
CC8 {חזן, מנגן, נבואה} merged here: the cantor/musician is called חזן from the word חזון (prophecy) because music draws from the prophetic source — same holy-music-as-kingdom domain.

CC9 {צפרדע, צפור דעה} merged here: the frog in the aggadic narrative is interpreted as צפור דעה (bird of knowledge), the symbolic singer whose throat-call (אקרא דהגרוניא) frames the entire Torah — it is the allegorical embodiment of holy neginah.
CC11 {כרובים, שתי צפרים} merged here: prophecy draws from the cherubim who ARE the two holy birds — explicit bechina in the text: 'הנבואה נמשכת מן הכרובים שהם בחינת שתי צפרים'.

packages.label: לַיְלָה וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
packages.reason: This cluster groups all concepts that share the essential nature of 'night as the dimension of Oral Torah.' Gemara IS night (from the Midrash about Moses who identified night by learning Oral Torah). The raven/crow (עורב) IS night (מלשון ערבית — from the word 'evening'). Torah she-be'al peh IS night — these are all three bechinas of the same single reality. The pair שמים/קול is merged here because in the text the verse 'ki gadol me'al shamayim chasdecha' — shamayim = kol (voice), and the voice is what is repaired through night-learning; it belongs to the same domain of 'night transforms voice' rather than the music/malkhut domain.
merge_notes: CC10 {שמים, קול} merged here: the verse 'כי גדול מעל שמים חסדך' — shamayim = kol (voice) in the Torah's reasoning; the kol that is repaired by night-learning. Shamayim-as-kol belongs to the night/oral-torah dimension rather than the holy-malkhut/neginah dimension, since the verse is cited to explain how the chesed drawn through night learning (=laylah) repairs the voice.

packages.label: צִפֳּרִים שֶׁבַּקְּלִפָּה וּנְגִינָה רְשָׁעָה
packages.reason: The evil mirror of Package 1. Just as holy music draws from the two holy birds who feed at the place where prophets nurse, evil music draws from the birds of the klipah who suck from 'the breasts of malkhut [of impurity].' The birds of the klipah ARE the mochin of malkhut diklipah — this is the exact structural mirror of the holy cluster (שתי צפרים חיות=בנין המלכות דקדשה, and צפרים שבקלפה=מחין שבמלכות דקלפה). The evil music that comes 'from behind holiness' (מאחר עלות, מאחורי הקדשה) belongs in this evil cluster: it IS the quality of being situated at the back of holiness rather than at the source.
merge_notes: CC5 {נגינה שאינו בקדשה, מאחר עלות מאחורי הקדשה} merged here: the evil/non-holy music IS the quality of 'being at the back of holiness' (מאחר עלות = מאחורי הקדשה), making it the same domain as the klipah-birds cluster. This is the evil neginah that mirrors Package 1's holy neginah.

packages.label: אַבְרָהָם, חֶסֶד וְהָאִילָן
packages.reason: The tree (אילן) in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's story is interpreted by the Maharsha as Abraham ('vayita eshel' — he planted a tree — = chesed). Therefore: אילן IS Abraham IS chesed. These three are different expressions of a single archetype: the inexhaustible protective power of chesed. This is the 'tree' whose strength Rabbah marvels at — 'ta chazei kamah nafish cheileh de'ilana' — because the thread of chesed drawn from Abraham's quality protects even one who learns shelo lishmah. This is a small but self-contained package representing the chesed-protection axis of the Torah.
